text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's true! Umastagram has a lot of photos
of
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, such fancy food. I can't make
anything like
that...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sure you can, Yukino. Taking off on
Umasta is all
about presentation!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you add some color to your usual
dishes, you
can make them look like
they came right from a
trendy cafe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cafe style! City gals are always eat'n
stuff like
that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I'd really have the sense to
spruce a
plate up like that. It seems
pretty difficult...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just leave that to me! ♪ I'll make sure
everything
looks as fab as can be! ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna try it out! Why don't the three
of us make
something?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by all means! I want to make
something
really cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All righty! And I'll post it on my Umasta
page
when it's done!
